summary: Creates a capture-region primitive, shaped like a capped tube, used to define volume-based weights for Capture SOP deformation workflows.

key_params.name: orient
key_params.note: Region axis; Z is typical inside a bone object

key_params.name: theight
key_params.note: Height from center to the top cap

key_params.name: bheight
key_params.note: Height from center to the bottom cap

key_params.name: weight
key_params.note: Max/min weights at the center line and edge of the region

key_params.name: color
key_params.note: Display color used for the capture region

common_gotchas: Capture regions are always wireframe so the influenced geometry stays visible.
Weight falloff blends between center-line and edge weights; size and cap shape directly change capture influence.
Use the same orientation convention as the bone hierarchy; Z axis is the expected region axis inside bone objects.
key_concepts: Capture Region SOP creates a capped-tube capture volume used by Capture SOP weighting.
Top and bottom halves have separate height and cap-shape controls around the center line.
Weights blend from center-line maximum to edge minimum based on distance through the region.
Capture-region primitives remain wireframe so influenced geometry can be seen while editing.
